programs.desc: After a long journey, our heroes reach China and land in the region of Guilin. Here they meet Zhi who, in a secret cave near the village, shows our heroes an ancient sacred drum.

programs.title: Bushwhacked
programs.desc: After a grueling journey involving mountain biking, abseiling, and kayaking to reach Bruny Island in Tasmania, Brandon finally reveals Kayne’s next mission: to locate one of the world’s tiniest surfers—penguins. The challenge combines adventure with wildlife observation, as Kayne must track these charming little creatures in their natural habitat, testing both his stamina and patience in equal measure.
